   - Reference calls

   - Key person dependencies

notes.title: TechFlow — Product Deep Dive Notes
notes.content:
TechFlow Product Analysis — Updated March 2026

Core product: AI agent platform for team productivity
- Agent orchestration (proprietary)
- Memory system (unique differentiator)
- Multi-modal interaction

Strengths:
- Alex's technical vision is 12-18 months ahead of competition
- Memory/context system has no direct equivalent in market
- Developer experience is excellent (high activation rates)

Weaknesses:
- Enterprise features lag (no SSO until Q3, no audit log)
- Mobile experience is poor
- API documentation needs work

- "Needs better admin controls" (4/5)

notes.title: TechFlow — Competitive Landscape
notes.content:
TechFlow Competitive Analysis — March 2026

Direct competitors:
1. CompetitorCo — $80M Series B, enterprise focus, 15% MoM growth
2. WorkspaceAI — Series A ($12M), SMB focus, weaker product but good GTM
3. TaskForge — Bootstrapped, $2M ARR, niche in engineering teams

Indirect competitors:
- Notion AI, Slack AI, Microsoft Copilot (big tech moving into space)
- Various point solutions (Otter, Fireflies, etc.)

TechFlow positioning: Best-in-class AI agents, mid-market sweet spot
Risk: Squeezed between enterprise (CompetitorCo) and big tech (Microsoft)

My take: TechFlow wins on product quality and technical depth. Needs to find and own a defensible wedge before big tech copies features.
